notes.title: Chip's Challenge 2 :: Version 2.1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8500364/69177e1fb9cb28f135f11927fd70d2525783fb75.png

Version 2.1 is a mini update which includes

1. Theme Win Music & SFX
2. Conveyor Belt Animation Off / On
3. Previous Level (Function F7)

It’s all been possible as we finally found a solution to the Microsoft immovable object vs. the Valve unstoppable force problem. Basically a config file needed to be set a specific way, but the knowledge of how and why was lost over 10 years ago.

The outcome is SteamWorks is now running as it should within Chip's Challenge 1, so you can play the game offline finally.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/348300/Chips_Challenge_2/

notes.title: Chip's Challenge 2 :: Version 2
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8500364/24ac10ec39d322ead07aadfb87f4334fa7bbc832.png

Version 2 is a massive update. We’ve been working on this one for a while and it’s finally live ːCC2MelindaːːCC1Chipː Chip’s Challenge 2 & Editor now include:

1. Offline Support
2. Steam Workshop Support
3. Level Set Editor
4. Several bug fixes, including the bug caused by holding down keys in record 
5. Preference Themes: Classic or Win

It’s all been possible as we finally found a solution to the Microsoft immovable object vs. the Valve unstoppable force problem. Basically a config file needed to be set a specific way, but the knowledge of how and why was lost over 10 years ago.

The outcome is SteamWorks is now running as it should within Chip's Challenge 2, which in turn means Level Set sharing is possible with WorkShop, plus offline works too.

There are already some new Level Sets live on Workshop:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1324616255&searchtext=


http://store.steampowered.com/app/348300/Chips_Challenge_2/

notes.title: Options Update v1.1
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8500371/356ccab6f7940742415c6e993d966ed07841f569.png

Since launch we’ve been gathering your requests and the biggest is we want more options. So here they are in a new Player preferences:

    Skin Support
    Music & SFX Volume Sliders
    Scrolling On/Off
    Screen Size Options

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8500371/4881b0802bcdc6171555e11acd799e99af8df374.png
Chip’s Challenge is one of the first games to have a large modder community. They worked out how the level were coded and reverse engineered a tools to make their own levels. That’s why we are modder fans and left the Steam code accessible. 

To further support this you can now select multiple skins, like this one from scutilla

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8500371/3d38c82bbc11c22f47062ee2e7f442b600c6c315.png

Music and SFX now have volume controls rather than simple on/off states. 

Want to play the game without any scrolling animation, like when PCs couldn’t handle the raw graphics power needed by Chip’s Challenge 25 years ago, now you can. 

Finally you can manually set what width you want or simply leave it on auto for the game to decide. So will you choose 4x for 4k, or have it the original tiny version?

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8500371/e28f58bd7fa08c101f6a5de0bbf7e5e4abc89810.png



http://store.steampowered.com/app/346850
http://store.steampowered.com/app/348300
